## Checklist

- [ ] Words are in Devanagari, in dictionary form (मड़ई, not मड़इया)
- [ ] Each meaning is in English, one meaning per sense
- [ ] New/edited entries are in `data/canonical/community-bho.jsonl`
- [ ] `python3 pipeline/validate_canonical.py` passes locally (CI also runs it)
